title: What Still Sleeps
introNarration: Alder does not lift the fork. He looks at you the way he looks at a load-bearing beam — the good yellow eye fierce, the scarred one already decided. The High Study smells of beeswax and old feathers. "Three can stand. South of the Cocoon Nave the cradle is no longer empty. I have felt it through these beams — a heavier note than the hatchling, a stillness that is not rest. I will not send one Collegian into that room. Take two classmates who can lock a move on the same clock as you. Examine the Still Score. If she squares up, do not invent heroics. Lock together. Then come back and talk alder here. This is the work I saved for students I trust to come home."
reminderNarration: Alder counts three on his talons. Moonlight still lies in a pale coin on the blotter. "East from the North Quad, then down, east, south, and south again, until the air grows warm and the silk hangs thick as winter curtains. Do not go alone. Examine the Still Score in the Deep Cradle — the blank note is the part I cannot see from this oak. If the Silk Queen stands, lock together. Then talk alder here. Type quests for the list. The school is watching this one, and I would rather watch you walk back up that stair."
completionNarration: You name the still score and the three who stood. Alder listens to the end. For a moment the fork answers a note too deep for the hour-bell, and the banners on the owl dais do not stir. "The silk has a mouth now, and it learned it from a class, not a rumour. That is enough. You did not invent a monster. You finished a lesson I could not fight for you. Go to class. Eat something warm. The High Study will keep the facts."

objectives.label: Reach the Deep Cradle with classmates. Alder will not accept a solo report from that room. Type south from the Cocoon Nave.
Examine the Still Score in the Deep Cradle. The blank note is the part Alder cannot see from the High Study.
Bring the cradle back to Alder in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall.
